snippet.title: UMvC3 Community Edition - Mega Man and Bass! | Character Reveal Trailer 3 BONUS
snippet.description:
The Blue Bomber Mega Man and his Rival Bass joins the cast in modded UMvC3!

============================================================================

↓ BASS CREDITS ↓

Moveset by @calikingz01
Animations help from Novembermann and EternalYoshi
@CaptainBackpak for the Theme remix
@Shumariachi for Trailer render art/intro comic render
VA - @BlueRazzRush 

↓ MEGA MAN CREDITS ↓

Moveset by @EternalYoshi, @heefmvc 
Animations by @EternalYoshi, BlazingFireOmega
Original concept by BlazingFireOmega & Eternal Yoshi
Effect work and Help by @Shumariachi  
Trailer Render Art by @Shumariachi 
Mega Man Medley Theme by @CaptainBackpak 
Thanks to Voltaic, Amongst Shadows, Calikingz, Gneiss and @Shumariachi for moveset related help
Thanks to anotak for mag_patch that made Beat Plane possible
Trailer by Kevin Ha (HAVENGERS)
Intro help by Moocartoons

First theme used - Jam Project Omoide wa Okkusenman! ➡️ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Nnl0ycLvgU
Second theme used MM2/MM3/MM4 remix melody by CaptainBackpak ➡️ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3-v-2TnQKHw

============================================================================

Direct Link to the UMvC3 Community Edition Build is included down below ⬇️

Nexusmods Link ➡️ https://tinyurl.com/596h8b57
Google Drive Link ➡️ https://tinyurl.com/mr332c2a

==============================================================

Interested in playing the mods but don't know how to install them? Here's a tutorial on how to install Clone Engine ➡ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xzgcwX1lqrw&t=33s

(DISCLAIMER: The download above is 5+ gigabytes as it also includes custom UI, custom music, up to 20 colors for some characters, and new stages!)

==============================================================

Twitch - https://twitch.tv/Kevin_Ha
Twitter - https://x.com/caucwasian
Discord - https://discord.gg/HAVENGERS
